Traffic deaths fell in 2023

An estimated 40,990 people died in motor vehicle traffic crashes in 2023, a decrease of about 3.6 percent compared with the 42,514 deaths reported for 2022.

This is the second year in a row that traffic deaths have declined, after a sharp rise in 2020 and 2021.

The fatality rate for 2023 fell to 1.26 deaths per 100 million vehicle miles traveled, down from 1.33 in 2022.

The agency says the estimate is based on preliminary crash data and will be updated when the final figures are published.
